question: A retail company runs seasonal promotions and sees unpredictable traffic spikes. Leadership wants faster feature delivery and less infrastructure management while keeping costs aligned to actual usage. Which compute approach best matches this goal?

options.text: Use fixed-size virtual machines in one zone
Use serverless services such as Cloud Run for bursty workloads
Buy additional on-premises servers for peak season
Use only manual scaling with a weekly capacity plan

explanation: Serverless options like Cloud Run reduce ops overhead, scale automatically, and align spend with demand, which is ideal for bursty traffic and rapid delivery cycles.

question: An executive team is comparing on-premises refresh versus cloud adoption. They ask why cloud often shifts spending from CapEx to OpEx. What is the best explanation?

options.text: Cloud removes all IT costs completely
Cloud requires only one-time license purchases
Cloud allows consumption-based pricing rather than upfront hardware purchases
Cloud forces all workloads into fixed annual contracts

explanation: Cloud consumption models typically move spending to operational expenses by charging for usage over time instead of large upfront hardware investments.

question: A healthcare startup must satisfy strict data residency requirements while still using cloud analytics. Which statement is most accurate?

options.text: Data residency can be ignored if encryption is enabled
Data residency concerns where data is physically stored and processed
Data residency only applies to social media applications
Data residency means only users from one country can log in

explanation: Data residency requirements focus on where data is stored/processed to comply with regulatory obligations. Cloud architecture must account for region choices and governance.

question: A business unit wants near real-time analytics from clickstream events generated by mobile users worldwide. Which product pair best supports ingestion and stream processing?

options.text: Cloud SQL and Memorystore
Pub/Sub and Dataflow
Compute Engine and Cloud DNS
Cloud Storage Archive and Filestore

explanation: Pub/Sub is a scalable messaging service and Dataflow is designed for stream/batch pipelines, making this pair the strongest fit for real-time event analytics.

question: A team needs a fully managed relational database for a standard transactional web app with familiar SQL engines. Which service is the best fit?

options.text: BigQuery
Cloud SQL
Cloud Storage
Pub/Sub

explanation: Cloud SQL provides managed relational databases (e.g., MySQL/PostgreSQL) and is a common fit for transactional applications requiring SQL semantics.

question: A global fintech platform requires strong consistency with horizontal scale across regions for mission-critical transactions. Which database option is most aligned?

options.text: Firestore in Datastore mode
Cloud Spanner
Cloud Bigtable
Cloud Storage Standard

explanation: Cloud Spanner is designed for globally distributed relational workloads with strong consistency and high availability at scale.

question: A product manager asks how Looker helps non-technical teams. What is the strongest answer?

options.text: It replaces IAM and network firewalls
It democratizes analytics through governed self-service dashboards and metrics
It is only used to train deep learning models
It stores backups in archival format

explanation: Looker enables broader business access to trusted data and self-service reporting, supporting data-driven decision making across teams.

question: A company wants to reduce risk from credential leakage in apps and CI pipelines. Which practice is most appropriate?

options.text: Hardcode API keys in source code so deployments are simpler
Store credentials in Secret Manager and grant least-privilege access
Share one admin account across all services
Disable logging to avoid exposing anything

explanation: Secret Manager centralizes secret handling and combines with IAM for least-privilege access, reducing credential exposure and improving auditability.

question: A CIO asks about Google Cloud shared responsibility. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Google is responsible for customer IAM role assignments
Customers are responsible for data, identities, and service configuration
Customers are not responsible for application security in PaaS
Google never manages physical infrastructure security

explanation: In shared responsibility, Google secures underlying cloud infrastructure while customers secure identities, data, and service-level configuration choices.

question: A team needs to run existing containerized apps with minimal Kubernetes management effort. Which service is usually the simplest fit?

options.text: Cloud Run
Compute Engine unmanaged instance groups
Bare-metal servers
Cloud Storage Nearline

explanation: Cloud Run is purpose-built for running containers serverlessly with minimal infrastructure management and automatic scaling.

question: A legacy line-of-business application cannot be heavily rewritten this year, but must move to cloud quickly. Which migration strategy is most realistic?

options.text: Reimagine entire architecture with a full rebuild now
Rehost (lift and shift) first, then optimize incrementally
Retire the application immediately with no replacement
Move all users to manual spreadsheet processing

explanation: Rehosting can reduce migration time and risk when refactoring is not immediately feasible, allowing phased modernization afterward.

question: A board member asks why AI projects often fail despite good models. Which response is best aligned with Google guidance?

options.text: Model quality is the only factor that matters
High-quality, well-governed data is foundational to reliable ML outcomes
More GPU spending always guarantees better outcomes
Security controls should be postponed until after launch

explanation: Data quality, governance, and responsible AI practices are central to successful ML; model choice alone cannot compensate for poor input data.

question: A startup wants to add language translation quickly with minimal ML expertise. Which option best fits speed and low implementation effort?

options.text: Build and train a custom transformer model from scratch
Use pre-trained Cloud Translation API
Run only manual human translation workflows
Use Bigtable replication for multilingual support

explanation: Pre-trained APIs are ideal when speed and low ML complexity are priorities; Cloud Translation provides managed language capabilities out of the box.

question: An engineering manager wants differentiated ML performance using proprietary business data and custom tuning. Which path is most suitable?

options.text: Use only static dashboards with no models
Use Vertex AI for custom model development and deployment
Store data in Archive class and wait for annual batch processing
Rely exclusively on generic pre-trained OCR models for all tasks

explanation: Vertex AI supports custom ML lifecycle workflows and is a strong choice when businesses need differentiated models trained on proprietary data.

question: A security team needs to protect internet-facing apps from common web exploits and volumetric attacks. Which Google Cloud service should be part of the solution?

options.text: Cloud Armor
Cloud Build
Cloud Composer
Cloud Source Repositories

explanation: Cloud Armor provides DDoS defense and WAF capabilities for protecting applications from external network and application-layer attacks.

question: Finance asks how to prevent unexpected cloud spend by development teams while preserving autonomy. Which combination is best?

options.text: Disable all project creation permanently
Apply budgets, alerts, and resource quotas with governance policies
Allow unlimited spend and review once per year
Use only on-premises servers for dev workloads

explanation: Budget thresholds, alerts, quotas, and governance controls improve cost predictability while still enabling team-level innovation.

question: A multinational enterprise wants one policy and management layer across on-premises and multiple clouds for Kubernetes workloads. Which platform is designed for this?

options.text: Anthos
Cloud DNS
Cloud SQL
Data Catalog

explanation: Anthos provides consistent management and policy controls across hybrid and multicloud Kubernetes environments.

question: Which storage class is typically most cost-effective for data accessed less than once per year for compliance retention?

options.text: Standard
Nearline
Coldline
Archive

explanation: Archive is optimized for long-term, infrequent access and generally provides the lowest storage cost for annual-or-less retrieval patterns.

question: A CTO wants to explain the difference between authentication and authorization to non-technical stakeholders. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Authentication decides what actions are allowed; authorization proves identity
Authentication verifies identity; authorization determines what that identity can do
They are identical terms in cloud security
Authorization is only required for public websites

explanation: Authentication answers who the user/service is; authorization defines permitted actions. Both are fundamental for cloud access control.

question: A product team needs SQL-based analytics and wants to build simple predictive models without moving data to an external ML platform. Which approach fits best?

options.text: Use BigQuery ML in the data warehouse
Export all data to spreadsheets and run formulas
Use only Cloud Functions for all ML training
Use Cloud Storage lifecycle rules as the model engine

explanation: BigQuery ML enables model creation and prediction using SQL directly in BigQuery, reducing movement and operational complexity for many use cases.

question: A business is deciding between IaaS and PaaS for a new digital product. Which tradeoff description is most accurate?

options.text: IaaS usually offers less control than PaaS
PaaS usually reduces ops burden, while IaaS usually offers more infrastructure control
PaaS requires more hardware management by the customer
IaaS and PaaS have identical responsibility models

explanation: PaaS abstracts more infrastructure operations for faster delivery, whereas IaaS provides greater infrastructure control with more management responsibility.

question: An operations lead needs clear monthly accountability by department for cloud spending and trend analysis. Which capability should be used first?

options.text: Cloud Billing Reports with proper project and label structure
Delete old projects to reduce reporting complexity
Use only command-line output from one billing account
Move all workloads to one shared project without labels

explanation: Billing Reports provide spend visibility and trend analysis. Combined with clean resource hierarchy and labels, they support accountability and financial governance.

question: A company wants to detect budget overrun risk early rather than after month-end. What is the most appropriate control?

options.text: Create budget thresholds and alert notifications
Wait for invoices before reviewing costs
Disable all logging to reduce storage costs
Increase project quotas whenever usage rises

explanation: Budget thresholds and alerts provide proactive visibility and allow teams to intervene before overspend becomes severe.

question: A platform team is designing for high availability. Which approach is most aligned with resilience best practices?

options.text: Deploy all critical services in one zone for simplicity
Distribute workloads across multiple zones and test failover
Rely only on nightly backups without redundancy
Avoid autoscaling to prevent variability

explanation: Multi-zone architecture with failover testing improves availability and resilience against localized failures.

question: A team must limit accidental resource sprawl in development projects while preserving experimentation. Which control is most suitable?

options.text: Set resource quotas per project
Grant Owner role to all engineers
Disable IAM so deployments never fail
Move all dev workloads to personal accounts

explanation: Quotas enforce practical guardrails on resource consumption and help control cost and capacity usage.

question: During a security review, leadership asks how to verify who changed IAM policies and when. Which capability provides this evidence?

options.text: Cloud Audit Logs
Cloud CDN cache logs only
Compute Engine metadata server
Cloud Build triggers alone

explanation: Cloud Audit Logs track administrative and data-access events, supporting investigations and compliance evidence.

question: A company wants to minimize vendor lock-in concerns while still using managed cloud services. Which strategy is most aligned with that goal?

options.text: Adopt open standards and portable architectures where practical
Avoid all managed services completely
Use only proprietary scripting without documentation
Disable APIs to reduce dependencies

explanation: Open standards and portability patterns can reduce switching costs while retaining cloud benefits where they deliver value.

question: A startup must transcribe customer support calls for quality analysis in multiple languages. Which Google Cloud API is the best fit?

options.text: Text-to-Speech API
Speech-to-Text API
Natural Language API only
Cloud Trace API

explanation: Speech-to-Text converts spoken audio into text for downstream analytics and quality workflows.

question: An enterprise requires centralized identity controls and strong access governance across many projects. Which principle should guide IAM design?

options.text: Least privilege and role-based access with regular reviews
Assign project Owner to all users for speed
Use one shared super-admin account for all teams
Avoid groups and policy inheritance

explanation: Least privilege with periodic access reviews reduces blast radius and supports compliance and operational security.

question: A support manager needs faster response for production incidents and asks what Google Cloud Customer Care provides. Which is most accurate?

options.text: It replaces all internal runbooks and on-call staff
It provides support pathways and case handling to assist cloud operations
It automatically rewrites application code
It is only available for free-tier anonymous users

explanation: Customer Care supports organizations through defined support processes and case management during cloud operations.

question: A sustainability officer asks how Google Cloud can support corporate emissions goals. Which response is strongest?

options.text: Sustainability is unrelated to cloud architecture choices
Cloud tools and efficient infrastructure can help track and reduce environmental impact
Only hardware procurement teams affect sustainability outcomes
Sustainability reporting requires disabling data analytics

explanation: Google Cloud provides infrastructure and tooling that can support sustainability analysis, reporting, and optimization initiatives.

question: A solution architect must explain multicloud versus hybrid cloud to executives. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Hybrid usually mixes on-prem and cloud, while multicloud uses multiple public clouds
Hybrid and multicloud always mean exactly the same architecture
Multicloud excludes managed services
Hybrid cannot use containers

explanation: Hybrid commonly spans on-prem plus cloud, while multicloud spans more than one public cloud provider.

question: A security architect wants to reduce account takeover risk beyond passwords for admins. Which control is most appropriate?

options.text: Enable two-step verification / multi-factor authentication
Store admin passwords in shared team chat
Disable account recovery options and audits
Rotate passwords once every ten years

explanation: MFA/2SV significantly reduces credential-based compromise risk for privileged identities.

question: A modernization program needs to expose internal capabilities to partners as digital products. Which concept creates this business opportunity?

options.text: API monetization and managed API lifecycle
Disabling all external connectivity
Using only private spreadsheets for integration
Replacing IAM with static IP allow lists only

explanation: APIs can expose reusable business capabilities and support partner ecosystems, with API management improving governance and reliability.

question: A data team stores clickstream logs, images, and transaction records. What best explains why cloud can unlock more value from this mix?

options.text: Cloud supports only structured relational data
Cloud services can process structured and unstructured data at scale
Unstructured data has no business value
Only data from one source type can be analyzed

explanation: Cloud platforms offer managed services across data types, enabling organizations to derive insights from previously underused unstructured data.

question: A startup has limited operations staff and wants to deploy web apps quickly with runtime managed by Google. Which service best matches this need?

options.text: App Engine
Compute Engine sole-tenant nodes only
Manual Kubernetes control plane on VMs
Cloud Interconnect

explanation: App Engine is a managed platform for deploying applications rapidly with reduced infrastructure management overhead.

question: Leadership asks why not adopting modern cloud capabilities can be risky. Which answer is strongest?

options.text: It can reduce competitiveness, agility, and time-to-market versus digital-first peers
It guarantees higher security automatically
It eliminates all operational complexity
It prevents any future compliance changes

explanation: Failure to modernize can slow innovation and responsiveness, increasing strategic risk in markets where digital capabilities matter.

question: A team needs event-driven code execution in response to object uploads without maintaining servers. Which service fits best?

options.text: Cloud Functions
Cloud SQL
BigQuery BI Engine
Cloud CDN

explanation: Cloud Functions is designed for event-driven serverless execution and integrates with cloud event sources such as storage events.

question: A governance team wants to organize cloud resources to enforce policy boundaries and access control at scale. What is foundational?

options.text: A clear resource hierarchy using organizations, folders, and projects
Putting all workloads in one unmanaged project
Using only local admin accounts for each VM
Avoiding IAM inheritance

explanation: Well-designed resource hierarchy supports delegated administration, policy inheritance, and scalable governance.

question: Which statement best captures the business value of Google Cloud global infrastructure for user-facing apps?

options.text: It can reduce latency and improve user experience by serving workloads closer to users
It guarantees zero outages in every scenario
It removes the need for architecture decisions
It is only useful for internal test environments

explanation: Global regions, zones, and networking capabilities support lower latency and improved availability when architected appropriately.
